study: Unassigned neural symbols for food/hazard scenes
selection: No seed retries, checkpoint admission, early stopping or test-based selection. Evaluate update 6000 only. Every run retained.
transfer_method: parallel selected on development seed97 before final training
transfer_interface: Four foods x two animal identities x two states =16 full-scene hypotheses; retrieve with whole-message listener. Size fixed0; existing CUDA navigator frozen. No retraining, symbol mapping or semantic word heads.

criteria.useful_communication: Heldout five-seed mean >=0.80, minimum >=0.65, mean normal-blocked >=0.30 and normal-shuffle >=0.30
criteria.local_productivity: Training-induced rewrite overall causal switch >=0.80 (coverage included)
criteria.order_binding: Each seed: >=50 same-bag/different-order heldout role pairs; >=90% both correct normally, <=55% both correct after sorting

qualifications: No claim of human language, recursion, morphology, pragmatic conversation, learned perception or learned path planning.
Parallel and invariance use eight fixed unassigned slots and a whole-scene reconstruction objective; no learned brevity claim.
Invariance explicitly biases role reversal to preserve token histograms, with extra TRAIN/TRAIN examples; this is an inductive bias, not unbiased emergence.
PPO is reward-driven RL; straight-through Gumbel games use target-room cross-entropy with a biased differentiable channel.
Population averages all9 sender/listener combinations; member0 fixed for code diagnostics.
Confidence intervals treat five training seeds as units; paired episodes within a seed are not independent training repetitions.
